title: Summarise a small dataset
summary: The mean is the total divided by the number of values. The minimum and maximum describe the range.
introduction: The mean is the total divided by the number of values. The minimum and maximum describe the range. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: The mean is the total divided by the number of values. The minimum and maximum describe the range.

blocks.code:
import numpy as np

scores = np.array([2, 4, 6])
print(float(scores.mean()), int(scores.min()), int(scores.max()))
blocks.title: Summarise a small dataset

blocks.text: The output is 4.0 2 6. These three summaries describe the center and the two ends of the data.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: One average can hide important differences between individual values.
